key_patterns.issue: Missing trust and credibility signals (brand identity, trust badges, security cues)
key_patterns.evidence: In the navigation section the simulated persona noted an information gap: 'Brand identity, trust badges, any indication of security or credibility.'

strongest_conversion_signals: The persona chose to continue after each visited section, indicating sustained interest despite information gaps.

recommended_actions.action: Add visible trust badges, security seals, and a brief brand credibility statement to the header/navigation area
recommended_actions.reason: Simulation showed the buyer needed brand identity and security cues before feeling safe to proceed.
